item.printer.printer.summary: Loads web images and prints reusable pictures.
item.printer.printer.workflow: Load a URL, choose size and frame, then Print.
item.printer.printer.paper: Uses one paper per block of picture area.
item.printer.printer.ink: Uses one color cartridge charge or ink sac per print.
item.printer.printer.output: Empty the output slot before printing another copy.
item.printer.printer.hoppers: Facing the front: hopper ink above, paper on your right.
item.printer.printer.extraction: Extract Images on your left or below the printer.
item.printer.printer.redstone: A rising redstone signal prints the saved image once.
item.printer.printer.busy: Signals while busy are ignored; held power does not repeat.
item.printer.color_cartridge.insert: Insert into the printer's ink slot or a hopper above it.
item.printer.color_cartridge.usage: One charge per print; a fresh cartridge has three charges.

item.printer.image.place: Use on a wall or insert into an item frame.
